say:2:1041570001:1.source_cn: 啊，真是麻烦……我讨厌工作。

say:3:1041570002:1.text: Don't get me wrong, it's not about any particular job or document. I just hate the whole idea of work itself.
say:3:1041570002:1.source_cn: 别误会，不是说具体的某件任务或者某份文件——我讨厌工作本身。

say:5:1041570004:1.text: Well now, that's a surprise. I had you pegged as another Indris—one of those tireless workaholics who think everyone should love their job as much as they do.
say:5:1041570004:1.source_cn: 咦？！真让人意外。我还以为你和因度厄一样，都是个热爱工...

say:6:1041570005:1.text:
Not even close.
The only reason I carry this burden is because someone has to.
say:6:1041570005:1.source_cn: 并非如此。\n我承担目前的职责与工作，完全是出于责任心。

say:7:1041570006:1.text: If I walked away, everything would collapse into chaos.
say:7:1041570006:1.source_cn: 如果我撒手不管，那么就无人可做，一切就会变得一团混乱。

say:8:1041570007:1.text: But I should make it clear: my sense of duty has its limits. If given the chance, I'd return it all to its rightful owner...
say:8:1041570007:1.source_cn: 但我必须声明，这份责任心绝非无限，只要有机会，我会希望...

say:9:1041570008:1.text: The power, the responsibilities, and the endless work that comes with them.
say:9:1041570008:1.source_cn: ——无论是权力，职责，还是无穷无尽的工作本身。

say:10:1041570009:1.text: Well said. I suppose I shouldn't have let a few careless comments from others give me the wrong impression of you.
say:10:1041570009:1.source_cn: 说得妙极了，我真不该凭着他人的三言两语就错判了你的个性。

say:11:1041570010:1.text: You hide behind a mask, same as I do. I have a feeling we'll get along splendidly, my friend.
say:11:1041570010:1.source_cn: 仔细瞧瞧，你也是个面具爱好者——我是说，我感觉我们会聊...

say:12:1041570011:1.text: How about we go somewhere quiet and draw up a proper plan to fix this mess?
say:12:1041570011:1.source_cn: 不如我们换个更安静的地方，聊聊如何改善情况的详细计划，如何？

say:13:1041570012:1.text: No need. I've had the plan all worked out for ages. Just haven't had the chance to set it in motion.
say:13:1041570012:1.source_cn: 不，这无需多谈，我早就有了详细的计划，只是缺少实施机会。

say:14:1041570013:1.text: Step one: wait for those two wanderers to come back. Step two: grab them and tie them down where they belong.
say:14:1041570013:1.source_cn: 第一步：等那两个在外游历的家伙回来。第二步：把他们捉住...

say:15:1041570014:1.text: Step three: with my limited sense of duty, take on only the work that's mine. Step four: enjoy a quiet, peaceful life.
say:15:1041570014:1.source_cn: 第三步：以我有限的责任心，承担属于我的有限的责任。第四...

say:16:1041570015:1.text: Trouble is, every time I'm ready for step two, they find some excuse to vanish before I can lay hands on them.
say:16:1041570015:1.source_cn: 目前来说，我尽管想执行第二步，但他们总在我来得及执行前...

say:17:1041570016:1.text:
...
Oh dear, that does sound unfortunate.

say:18:1041570017:1.text:
It is.
Still, in a recent chat, Indris mentioned he's something of an expert in this sort of thing.
say:18:1041570017:1.source_cn: 确实。\n不过幸好，此前闲聊时，因度厄曾说过，在这方面...

say:19:1041570018:1.text: I even asked him for advice, though... he hasn't written back yet.
say:19:1041570018:1.source_cn: 因此，我曾向他请教过相关的经验，但他好像还没回信……

say:20:1041570019:1.text:
Uh...
Come to think of it, my dear friend, isn't this a bit heavy a topic for your lovely, feathered companion?
say:20:1041570019:1.source_cn: ……呃……\n说起来，我亲爱的朋友，这种话题在你这位长...

say:21:1041570020:1.text: For the sake of our shared love of fine masks, why don't we change the subject to something lighter?
say:21:1041570020:1.source_cn: 看在咱们共同的漂亮面具的份上，换个轻松的话题吧？
